examples.name: ListPage
examples.summary: A first-level list page: medium h1, one-line description, and the outlined Documentation and create actions on the right; on a phone they stack, each at full width.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import PageHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/page-header'
</script>

<template>
  <PageHeader
    title="Resources"
    description="View and manage your resources."
  >
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        label="Documentation"
        icon="pi pi-book"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
        href="https://example.com/docs/resources"
        target="_blank"
      />
      <Button
        label="Create Resource"
        icon="pi pi-plus"
        kind="outlined"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </PageHeader>
</template>

examples.name: SettingsPage
examples.summary: A settings sub-page or a detail tab: small title and description, no actions.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PageHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/page-header'
</script>

<template>
  <PageHeader
    title="Settings"
    description="Core configuration for this resource."
    size="small"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The three heading scales: large for a creation hub headline, medium for a first-level page, small for detail tabs and settings sub-pages.
